sources.title: Central African Republic passport and visa
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Danish Foreign Ministry page, updated 6 June 2026, specifically addresses Danish citizens but expressly says it has no further visa information.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visumpligt. Vi har ikke yderligere oplysninger om visumregler

sources.title: Embassy travel information: Central African Republic
sources.publisher: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Sweden
sources.officialityEvidence: Sweden Abroad's live page, updated 4 May 2026, directly addresses Swedish citizens but limits itself to visa liability and referrals to CAR embassies.

sources.title: Central African Republic travel advice and advisories
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Government of Canada page, updated 20 August 2026, separately identifies entry rules for a Regular Canadian passport and labels the tourist visa required.

sources.title: Central African Republic Travel Advice & Safety
sources.publisher: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade, Australian Government
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Smartraveller page directs Australian travellers to a CAR mission for visa details and says France's Sydney consulate may help, but supplies neither a nationality result nor a confirmed issuance process.
sources.supportingExcerpt: contact the nearest Embassy or Consulate of the Central African Republic

sources.title: Short-stay visa
sources.publisher: Embassy of the Central African Republic in France
sources.officialityEvidence: The CAR government's live Paris Embassy short-stay visa page gives an operational online-or-paper process, requires the passport and documents to be sent to the embassy for processing, and provides return of the visa by post.
sources.supportingExcerpt: envoyez le tout à l'adresse de l'ambassade pour le traitement

sources.title: Central African Republic travel advice
sources.officialityEvidence: Ireland's live DFA API destination advice is for Irish citizens, says it remains current on 22 August 2026, requires a CAR visa and identifies the CAR Embassy in Paris for visa applications.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Irish citizens require a visa ... contact the Embassy ... in Paris.

sources.title: Viaggiare Sicuri: Central African Republic entry requirements
sources.publisher: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Crisis Unit
sources.officialityEvidence: MAECI's live destination PDF says an entry visa is necessary for Italian travellers and directs entry enquiries to the Central African Republic Embassy in Paris, which publishes the current short-stay process.

policies.title: Irish ordinary passports: CAR Paris Embassy short-stay visa
policies.summary: Ireland's current DFA advice requires Irish citizens to have a CAR visa and identifies the CAR Embassy in Paris; the Embassy's current short-stay page specifies the pre-travel passport-submission and visa-return process.
conditions: Applies to an Irish citizen travelling on an ordinary passport for a short visit.
Before travel, use the CAR Embassy in Paris's online or paper short-stay process and submit the passport and required documents for processing.
The source does not establish a guaranteed grant, duration, purpose-specific requirements, residence jurisdiction, carrier service or final admission.

policies.title: Italian ordinary passports: CAR Paris Embassy short-stay visa
policies.summary: Italy's current MAECI guidance requires an entry visa and directs Italian travellers to the CAR Embassy in Paris; the Embassy's current short-stay page specifies the pre-travel passport-submission and visa-return process.
conditions: Applies to an Italian citizen travelling on an ordinary passport for a short visit.
Before travel, use the CAR Embassy in Paris's online or paper short-stay process and submit the passport and required documents for processing.
The source does not establish a guaranteed grant, duration, purpose-specific requirements, residence jurisdiction, carrier service or final admission.
